upstream.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
upstream.notes: hermes gateway run 是官方入口；设置 API_SERVER_ENABLED=true 与 API_SERVER_KEY 后，网关会同时监听 8642 并提供 /health。依赖改用 PyPI 包安装，避免源码构建时的可选依赖冲突。

commands.setup: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple hermes-agent
commands.start: python -c "from hermes_cli.main import main; raise SystemExit(main())" gateway run

integration.summary: 2026-11-13 Linux 实测：PyPI 包 hermes-agent 0.15.x 用 `hermes gateway run` 启动，配合 API_SERVER_ENABLED=true 与 API_SERVER_KEY，http://127.0.0.1:8642/health 返回 200。该命令在 Windows 上需再复验一次。

commands.setup: python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip && python3 -m pip install --target vendor/${CLAWHERMES_RUNTIME_KEY} hermes-agent aiohttp==3.13.3
commands.start: python3 -c "from hermes_cli.main import main; raise SystemExit(main())" gateway run

integration.summary: macOS adapter uses portable python3 plus a movable vendor/<darwin-arch> dependency directory prepared on a macOS build host; start runs hermes_cli.main from USB_ROOT without reusing the Windows venv.

commands.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple hermes-agent
